issues.description: The problem statement's UML and textual description specify checkOrderReady() as returning void, but the solution implementation declares checkOrderReady() to return boolean. This mismatch can confuse students about the required method signature and return type when they implement SealSaloon according to the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across artifacts. Preferably change the implementation signature to public void checkOrderReady() (remove the boolean return) so it matches the UML and problem description, or alternatively update the problem statement and UML to indicate a boolean return if that was intentional.
